tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The ARUON catalog: every report with its price (or null where it is quoted), whether it can be ordered now, whether it is instant pay, the turnaround, a sample and the terms. The same records as https://reir.aruon.ai/pricing.json. Empty, with a reason, while ordering is closed.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: How well ARUON holds a place for one report: band full_data (24-hour clock where sla_hours is set), area_scan, zip_only or unknown, with the reason. The answer the order page reads. A band other than full_data, or ok=false, means an analyst confirms scope before anything is charged.

tools.name: confirm_crypto_payment
tools.description: The six-digit code mailed to the human buyer's inbox: ask the person for it; it is never sent to you. Answers with the quote (coin, network, exact amount, address, 20 minutes to send) or the hold and who must act. If the quote expires before a payment arrives, call request_new_quote.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: list_products, create_order, start_crypto_payment, request_new_quote · Public sink: get_order_status, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment, request_new_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order_status · Private data: list_products, create_order, start_crypto_payment, request_new_quote · Public sink: get_order_status, start_crypto_payment, confirm_crypto_payment, request_new_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
